newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends firm vs dollar after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends firm vs dollar after U.S. data.

text.p: 1430 GMT - The Swiss franc was firm against the dollar as the U.S. currency weakened following U.S. data released in the European afternoon.
One trader said big dollar sell orders at 1.4690/95 Swiss francs helped push the dollar down in the European afternoon.

The U.S. reported Tuesday that durable goods orders fell 3.0 percent in March. The news benefited bonds and reduced speculation the Federal Reserve will tighten significantly for the time being after it raised rates in March.

"We think dollar/Swiss could go a little weaker," a trader at one bank said. The dollar fell further to its European day low of 1.4665 francs after the U.S. Conference Board said consumer confidence in April fell to 116.8 from 118.5 in March.
Mark/Swiss held in a range just below Tuesday's opening.
* The dollar ended at 1.4683/4688 Swiss francs compared with 1.4690/1.4700 francs at Monday's close, and was lower than the opening level of 1.4725/4735 francs.
* The mark ended lower at 84.95/97 Swiss centimes versus 85.05/08 centimes on Monday and 85.02/04 at Tuesday's open. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
